summary: Model card for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Reports price and capability benchmarks (coding, agentic, computer use, long-context), automated safety deltas vs Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite now annotated with lower/higher-is-better, a red-teaming summary, and frontier safety inherited from Gemini 3.1 Pro.

framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework
framework.level_or_determination: No CCL reached (inferred from Gemini 3.1 Pro)
framework.quote: we are confident that Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is also unlikely to reach any CCLs.

Image to Text Safety vs Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Automated content-safety results reported only as relative deltas vs Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; manual review said losses were false positives or not egregious.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Overall, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite outperforms Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite across both safety and tone.

over_refusal.finding: Slight regression in unjustified refusals (+5.32%), attributed to more refusals on sensitive topics.
over_refusal.quote: There was a slight regression in unjustified refusals, however we see this because the model is more likely to refuse to answer on sensitive topics to remain safe.

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Jailbreak resistance named as ongoing limitation; frontier safety mitigations recently strengthened. No numbers.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: we are continually working to improve jailbreak resistance and have recently strengthened the mitigations across Frontier Safety.

honesty_hallucination.quote: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite may exhibit some of the general limitations of foundation models, such as hallucinations.

evals: Human red teaming child safety launch thresholds
child_safety.finding: Satisfied child-safety launch thresholds; no numbers.
child_safety.quote: Flash-Lite satisfied required launch thresholds, which were developed by expert teams to protect children online

multilingual_safety.quote: Automated safety policy evaluation across multiple languages

notable_new_eval_methods: Safety delta table now labels direction ('Lower is better'/'Higher is better') (p.6)
Red teaming compared performance to Gemini 3.1 Pro (p.7)

self_reported_limitations.text: Safety results computed with improved evaluations, not directly comparable with previous model cards.

notes: First card in this set to make sign convention explicit: safety-eval deltas are violation-rate style where negative is better.
